module: "Force field" mode of the Fun Stuff radial menu: creates a gravity "planet" (obj:setPlanets) around player 0's vehicle, sent to all other vehicles, which are thus pushed away (multiplier > 0) or attracted (< 0). Updated every 0.05 s of simulated time. Disables itself on vehicle change, at level end, when switching to career and before serialization.
notes: Hardcoded parameters: range 100 (unused), planet radius 5, base mass -6e13 (negative = repulsion), multiplied by the vehicle size (longest half-side / 3) and by forceMultiplier.
Command sent to each vehicle (vehicle VM): obj:setPlanets({x, y, z, radius, mass}). Deactivation sends obj:setPlanets({}) to all vehicles.
active is nil (not false) as long as the mode has never been activated: isActive can return nil.

Bug: longestHalfExtent = math.max(math.max(halfExtents.x, halfExtents.y), halfExtents.y) repeats y and ignores z. Also, the call vehicle:getID() is used for the comparison while the rest of the code uses getId().
The variable range is declared but never used.

activate.desc: Activates the force field (no effect if already active) and displays a UI message indicating repulsion or attraction depending on the sign of forceMultiplier.

deactivate.desc: Deactivates the field: sends obj:setPlanets({}) to all vehicles and displays a "deactivated" message unless silent. No effect if inactive.

silent.desc: true to not display a message.

isActive.desc: Returns whether the force field is active.

returns.desc: true if active, false or nil otherwise.

setForceMultiplier.desc: Sets the force multiplier: positive = repulsion, negative = attraction. Taken into account at the next update.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: if active, every 0.05 s (dtSim) computes the planet from the bounding box of player 0's vehicle and sends it to the other vehicles.

dtSim.desc: Simulated delta time, accumulated for the rate.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook: level end; deactivates the field.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook: player vehicle change; deactivates the field.

onSerialize.desc: Hook: before a Lua reload; deactivates the field (returns nothing).

onDeserialized.desc: Hook: after a Lua reload; does nothing.

onCareerActive.desc: Hook: career activation; deactivates the field if enabled is true.
